definitions.explanation: An indication or sign that something is about to happen. Can be used for both positive and negative future events.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{予兆|よちょう}
⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧⟦{不吉|ふきつ}→不吉：16952_fukitsu⟧な{予兆|よちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
{景気回復|けいきかいふく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{予兆|よちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}え→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦{始|はじ}めている→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: Signs of economic recovery are beginning to appear.

notes:
USAGE: {予兆|よちょう} is used for observable signs or indications of future events. It can apply to natural phenomena, social trends, or personal situations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {予兆|よちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (to sense an omen)
- {予兆|よちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧/⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (signs appear/exist)
- ⟦{不吉|ふきつ}→不吉：16952_fukitsu⟧な{予兆|よちょう} (ominous sign)
- ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧/⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{予兆|よちょう} (sign of illness/disaster)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{前兆|ぜんちょう}→前兆：09118_zenchou⟧ (forewarning - similar but often more concrete)
- ⟦{兆候|ちょうこう}→兆候：11523_choukou⟧ (symptom, sign - more neutral/clinical)
- ⟦{兆|きざ}し→兆し：06633_kizashi⟧ (sign, indication - native Japanese word)
